card.name: Capsule or tablet after a dose strength
card.fires_on: The unit noun (capsule, tablet) right after a strength such as 'one 60 mg' in dosing instructions. It also fires on 'altitude' after 'Pressure' in aviation text.

modes.label: Unit form after strength
modes.description: The word capsule or tablet follows 'one' plus a mg amount in a dosage line.
modes.example: One 100 mg<< capsule>> every 12 hours for seven days

modes.label: Aviation altitude terms

modes.example: - Pressure<< altitude>> – the air pressure in terms of altitude
